venue_policy.authority: User instruction: count companion/Demo/Challenge proceedings as the main conference, excluding workshops; tolerate special characters lost in ETIS exports.
rules: Official companion tracks, including demonstrations, challenges, findings and late-breaking papers, count as the parent conference. Prefer its listed main entry; otherwise accept the exact listed track.
Workshops never inherit the host conference identity, including workshops in companion volumes. A listed workshop can match its own entry.

Missing punctuation, ampersands, corrupted HTML entities and connective and do not change identity when the remaining full venue name is clear. Different substantive words still identify different venues.
Output catalogue IDs and canonical names remain exact; no fuzzy scoring of different journals.
